runs.note: Peak essentially unchanged (-0.16%, within noise): the analyze peak does not live in the optimized tools. Live sampling during the after run showed nar-analyze itself at ~386 MB while its stage subprocesses ran, spiking to a ~1.54 GB plateau immediately after the nar-dex subprocess exited and staying there. The DEX stage document for this input is 298 MB compact (373 MB as the indented companion); nar-analyze captures that stdout whole, json.loads it into a full dict graph, json.dumps it twice (stage cache + companion), and retains it for correlations. Fixing that means restructuring the orchestrator's stage plumbing, which W4 explicitly did not do.
